messages.content: I'll research this topic systematically. Since the request asks for a report distinguishing established facts from disputed claims with Wikipedia sources cited, I'll investigate the origin of SARS-CoV-2 — a case where the split between established and contested information is unusually well documented. Let me first note that no specific topic was attached to the request, so I have selected this representative subject and applied the requested structure; the same framework can be reused for any topic.

subtopics: Established timeline of the earliest known COVID-19 cases in Wuhan in December 2019: first symptom-onset dates, the Huanan Seafood Wholesale Market link, early hospital notifications, and how many early December cases had a direct market connection

Key virological facts about SARS-CoV-2 origins: closest known bat coronavirus relatives (RaTG13, BANAL-52/BANAL-236), the furin cleavage site and its significance, and which virological features scientists consider established versus debated

WHO-convened investigations into COVID-19 origins: the 2021 China-WHO joint study conclusions, the Scientific Advisory Group for the Origins of Novel Pathogens (SAGO) reports of 2022-2023, and criticisms about access and transparency

US intelligence community assessments of COVID-19 origins: the 2021 ODNI unclassified report, the 2023 declassified report, differing agency conclusions (FBI, Department of Energy, NSA, others) and their stated confidence levels, plus the December 2024 House Select Subcommittee final report

Evidence for and against natural spillover at the Huanan Seafood Wholesale Market: the 2022 Science papers by Pekar et al. and Gao et al., environmental sampling results, early case geolocation, and counterarguments raised by lab-leak proponents
